title: QQ (Multiplication Table)
description: Write generate_multiplication_table() that returns a list of formatted strings 'ixj=val' for 1<=i<=9 and 1<=j<=9.
expected_behavior: Returns 81 multiplication entries starting with '1x1=1' and ending with '9x9=81'

test_cases.test_script:
table = generate_multiplication_table()
assert len(table) == 81
assert table[0] == '1x1=1'
assert table[-1] == '9x9=81'

title: Bank Account Class
description: Create a BankAccount class with deposit(amount) and withdraw(amount) methods returning updated balance.

test_cases.test_script:
acc = BankAccount(100)
acc.deposit(50)
assert acc.balance == 150
acc.withdraw(30)
assert acc.balance == 120
